evidence.title: When Names Cross Scripts: A Source-Grounded Benchmark for Historical Entity Reconciliation in the Mongol World

summary: Researchers have introduced a benchmark that aligns and reconciles historical entities across different scripts and sources in the Mongol world, improving the accuracy of cross‑lingual historiography. The dataset and evaluation framework aim to facilitate AI models that can reliably link names appearing in varied orthographies and archival materials.
title: New source‑grounded benchmark advances historical entity reconciliation for Mongol-era records
